import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# Correct the function name to match the actual GSL function
fft_complex_radix2_forward = gsl.gsl_fft_complex_radix2_forward
fft_complex_radix2_forward.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
fft_complex_radix2_forward.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Helper function to convert numpy array to ctypes array
def np_to_ctypes(arr):
    return arr.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))

# Main function to perform FFT
def fft_complex_radix2_forward_python(data, stride, n):
    data_ctypes = np_to_ctypes(data)
    result = fft_complex_radix2_forward(data_ctypes, stride, n)
    return result
